items.title: The census rows still open
items.body: Registered cards whose triggers no carrier takes yet: an optional payment whose reflexive trigger is the effect (Guide of Souls), a delayed return at the next end step (Phelia), the city's blessing and token copies (Ocelot Pride), a cast trigger that works from the graveyard (Vengevine), manifest dread (Abhorrent Oculus). Each is sized first, built at ten or more pool cards, and otherwise recorded as a gap.

items.title: State-based actions only at priority
items.body: State-based actions are checked when a player would receive priority, never in the middle of a resolution (CR 704.3). Every seeded game and anchor game that changes is replayed before the change is accepted.

items.title: Dimir Midrange, root cause first
items.body: Best-of-three replays against Boros Energy and Azorius Control (WST v2) name the AI subsystem where expected value diverges from correct play. The finding is written up in docs/ before any code.

items.title: The legacy path keeps shrinking
items.body: Every unit moves hosts from the legacy fallback to the typed path. Gate parity's fallback count and the name-keyed registry may only fall, so the shrink cannot be quietly undone.

items.title: Marvel Super Heroes in the card database
items.body: The set is still missing. The refresh needs an environment that can reach mtgjson.com.
